name: com.bloknoter.unitygit
description: Work with your project's git repository inside the Unity Editor: repo info, commit, push, fetch, pull, branch switching, a preview of each change, reverting changes and conflict resolution, updates of UnityGit and FlexGit, plus optional main-toolbar buttons. Requires FlexGit: first add https://github.com/Bloknoter/FlexGit.git#upm/v2.2.0 to Packages/manifest.json.
